about: Which addresses a Plugin's network: site counts as public (decision Q97): roster-core's plugin/network.rs is_public, and the fake Backend's port of it (app/src/backend/fakePlugins.ts, publicAddress), both tested on this table. Not public: this computer, private and link-local networks, shared address space (CGNAT), multicast, documentation and reserved ranges, and an IPv6 address that carries one of those (mapped, compatible, 6to4, NAT64). Add a case here, not to one side's tests.
